raw_snippet: The survey found that, on average, only 48% of AI projects make it into production, and it takes 8 months to go from AI prototype to production.
note: Gartner survey fielded in the fourth quarter of 2023 (dated at its end); a second survey family beside IDC/Lenovo measuring the share of projects that reach production. The live Gartner page refuses the fetcher, so an archived raw copy is cited.
